description: Codex: Space Marines (11e) Space Wolves CO-ORDINATED STRIKE (Saga of the Beastslayer, 1 CP) at the end of the OPPONENT's Fight phase — WP-S3. Fixture sw11e_s3_reactive (P1 Orks ACTIVE vs P2 Space Wolves, round 2; layout in tests/helpers/gen_sw11e_s3_fixtures.gd). Setup privileges: the Space Wolves player gets all three Space Wolves detachments (stratagems reloaded), auto wound allocation, the Ork player has 0 CP (no Ork stratagem windows — not under test), straight to the phase under test. Setup privilege: every engaged unit counts as having fought (the fights are not under test). The players end the Ork Fight phase with real clicks (End Pile In, End Fight Phase + confirmations, End Consolidation); fight_phase_end opens for the Space Wolves player with Thunderwolf Cavalry B (unengaged, within 9" of the left battlefield edge) but not the engaged Blood Claws; a real click spends 1 CP and places the cavalry in strategic reserves (off the board).
